faqs.question: What is WhatsApp Business API in the UAE, and how can businesses use it?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API, also known as the WhatsApp Business Platform, helps growing businesses connect with customers without managing every conversation manually. It supports bulk campaigns, AI chatbots, CRM integrations, automated notifications, and customer support with multiple agents.
  • Businesses across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the UAE can use it to manage sales enquiries, booking confirmations, order updates, and customer conversations.
  • With MSG91, businesses can access WhatsApp Business API at rates lower than Meta's standard pricing, run campaigns without coding, and manage customer interactions through one platform.

faqs.answer:

  • MSG91 offers WhatsApp messaging rates approximately 13% lower than Meta's standard AED list rates, along with a no-code dashboard for campaigns and chatbots.

  • You also get AI chatbots and MSG91 Hello, a customer support platform where teams can manage conversations through a shared inbox.
  • Trusted by 30,000+ businesses globally, MSG91 helps UAE businesses simplify customer communication without managing multiple disconnected tools.

faqs.question: What is the pricing of the WhatsApp Business API in the UAE?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API pricing in the UAE has two parts: messaging charges and a platform subscription. MSG91 offers messaging rates approximately 13% lower than Meta's standard AED pricing for the UAE.
  • MSG91's UAE rates are:
    • Marketing: AED 0.184 per message
    • Utility: AED 0.05027 per message
    • Authentication: AED 0.05027 per message
    • Authentication International: AED 0.1631 per applicable message
    • Service: AED 0.05027 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 Titan plan costs AED 20/month, with the first two months free. Messaging charges and applicable taxes are separate.
  • For example, 10,000 billable marketing messages cost AED 1,840 with MSG91, compared with AED 2,115 at Meta's standard rate, saving AED 275 before subscription fees and taxes.
  • Actual savings depend on messaging volume and applicable pricing tiers.
  • Compare MSG91 WhatsApp Business API Pricing in the UAE with Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Pricing.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 AI WhatsApp chatbots communicate in Arabic and English and handle customer enquiries?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 AI-powered WhatsApp chatbots can communicate in Arabic and English and combine rule-based workflows with AI-powered conversations within a single bot. You don't need separate bots for predefined steps and intelligent responses.
  • The chatbot can connect with 2,000+ apps, make API calls, and use real-time information from connected business systems to handle routine questions and complex enquiries, including product recommendations, order tracking, lead qualification, and appointment bookings.
  • Businesses can also choose from multiple AI models and configure backup models, helping maintain conversations if the primary model becomes unavailable.
  • For example, a Dubai hotel can use one bot to guide guests through booking steps, answer room-related questions using AI, check connected reservation details through APIs, and assist in Arabic or English.
  • When personal assistance is needed, the conversation moves to a human agent through MSG91 Hello, where teams manage enquiries from a shared inbox. Agents can also access conversations through the Hello mobile app.
  • Explore MSG91 WhatsApp AI Chatbots, the Shopify integration guide, and the Hello mobile application.

faqs.question: How can UAE businesses reduce WhatsApp support costs after Meta's October 2026 pricing changes?
faqs.answer:
• Since October 1, 2026, Meta has charged for service messages beyond the monthly free allowance. The first 1,000 service messages per business phone number remain free each month, while additional billable messages cost AED 0.05027 each with MSG91 in the UAE.
  • Utility templates sent within an active customer service window also became chargeable, subject to applicable exceptions.
  • For businesses handling hundreds of customer enquiries every day, these charges can add up.
  • MSG91 Chat Window helps reduce these expenses through a simple process: WhatsApp → Chat Window → Hello.
  • Customers start on WhatsApp and continue the conversation through a dedicated Chat Window. AI chatbots and human agents can then assist them through Hello without sending every reply through WhatsApp.
  • Messages exchanged inside Chat Window do not incur Meta's WhatsApp messaging charges. Messages sent through WhatsApp remain chargeable.
  • Follow the MSG91 Chat Window setup guide to learn how it works.

faqs.question: Can businesses send WhatsApp OTPs to customers in the UAE using MSG91?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 allows UAE businesses to send WhatsApp OTPs for account verification, logins, and other eligible authentication workflows.
  • Authentication messages to UAE numbers cost AED 0.05027 per message with MSG91, lower than Meta's standard rate of AED 0.0576.
  • What happens if a customer doesn't receive an OTP? The MSG91 OTP Widget supports configurable verification and retry options across SMS, WhatsApp, voice, and email, depending on the selected setup. OTP Widget billing may differ from standard WhatsApp API messaging rates.
  • This is particularly useful for UAE fintech applications, e-commerce stores, and digital services where customers need to verify their identity before continuing.
  • Businesses can configure supported OTP workflows or integrate them using MSG91 APIs.
  • Explore MSG91 OTP and the OTP Widget integration guide.
